message: Last summer, we had an unexpected blackout during dinner. The kids were a mix of excited and confused, while I was scrambling for flashlights and trying to keep the fridge door shut. We ended up playing flashlight tag, and I realized how much fun we could have in the dark. It reminded me that a little preparedness can turn an inconvenience into an adventure. Now, I keep a stash of power banks and lanterns handy for next time—who knew that a power outage could spark such creativity?
